build_escnmd_block: build an eSCNMD_Block with sphere channels, hidden channels, lmax, mmax, and normalization type
create_edgewise_module: create an Edgewise module with SO2 convolutions, gate or s2 activation, and edge channels
create_spectral_atomwise: create a SpectralAtomwise module with SO3 linear layers and gate activation for atom-wise operations
create_grid_atomwise: create a GridAtomwise module that projects to SO3 grid, applies MLP, and projects back
set_mole_ac_start_index: set the activation checkpoint start index on all MOLE submodules within a given module
